DEF-260.title: The rendered creative iframe has no accessible name
DEF-260.expected: The creative frame is exposed with a meaningful accessible name so assistive-technology users can identify its contents.
DEF-260.actual: The banner iframe is rendered and revealable, but carries no title or ARIA naming attribute. The independent browser scenario reports the absent accessible frame name.
DEF-260.evidence: 2026-09-08-final-corpus/a11y-acceptance/run-FZ18zN/ux-a11y-findings.json first records iframePresent=true and iframeTitle=null. The verification at a11y-acceptance/verified-C7zwzP/ux-a11y-findings.json confirms names-desktop.measured.frameAccessibleName is {found:true,name:'',ignored:false}; screenshots/a11y-names-desktop-final.png shows the rendered frame. The exact gap remains present while all other checks in the scenario pass.
